versions.content: When CanIf calls the function Can_Write() for prioritized L-PDUs and Transmit Requests stored in CanIfTxBuffer and the return value of Can_Write() is E_OK , then CanIf shall remove this L-PDU or Transmit Request from the Transmit L-PDU Buffer immediately, before the transmit confirmation re- turns.
